name: Spoilboard Toolbox
author: tmuka
description: Zero on your spoilboard's dog holes in two taps: jog near a hole and X0 Y0 snaps to it exactly, no probing or typed coordinates. Swap work Z0 between spoilboard and stock top for any measured tool without re-probing. Fit the grid to the real board by probe or by eye, then cut the dog holes, T-tracks, chamfers and labels, and drill bolt or flip-pin holes through stock, from the same grid. Formerly Zero Swapper. For grblHAL.
